description.en:
Tells whether the camera move started with CamCtrlMoveTo is still going on. It returns the opposite of the camera-control state's finished flag.
sysCamCtrlStep sets that flag once all queued moves are done, or at once when no move is queued. sysCamCtrlStep also calls CMND_CHECK_MOVE_CAMERA to wait for the engine move, but without the camera handle that command needs, so it always gets null and never delays the end. CamCtrlReset and CamCtrlMoveTo clear it.
WaitCamCtrlMoving(_hcam) is the ev_main loop that waits on it.
The camera-control helpers keep their state in subev_ctx.cam_ctrl, the context of an event started by CallEvent. While such an event runs, CallEvent calls sysCamCtrlStep every frame: it applies the engine's camera move (CMND_GET_MOVE_INFO_CAMERA) to the camera, keeps the look-at point on the followed character when there is one, and marks the move as finished once it is over (see IsCamCtrlMove).
true while the camera move is still going on, false once it is finished.
